remarks: Welcome to 13 W Washington Ave, Unit 15! Experience the best of downtown Stamford living in this beautifully updated 1bd-1b apartment. This move-in-ready apartment offers modern finishes, exceptional convenience, and a prime location just minutes from everything the city has to offer. Inside, you'll find a bright and inviting living space featuring new flooring throughout and an updated kitchen. Located in the heart of downtown, you'll enjoy easy access to Stamford's top restaurants, cafes, bars, shopping, parks, UConn Stamford, Stamford Hospital, the Metro-North train station, and major highways-making commuting and entertainment effortless. Residents also benefit from an assigned parking spot and basement storage. Don't miss the opportunity to live in one of Stamford's most convenient locations. Schedule your showing today and make 13 W Washington Ave your next home!
